[!buildmode:plugin] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=plugin requires external linking'

env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOPROXY=off
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=
cd m
cp arena-off.toml logos.toml

# The test builds its plugin with a bare go build (no -O), which re-executes
# as logos in this marked module. Plugin identity requires matching
# optimization and experiment settings, so the host's effective level flows
# to the child in LOGOS_OPT_LEVEL. Unconfigured mixed-driver failures remain
# separate evidence.
logos test -O=1 -count=1 -run '^TestChildPlugin$' .
go test -O=1 -count=1 -run '^TestChildPlugin$' .
logos test -O=2 -count=1 -run '^TestChildPlugin$' .
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
logos test -O=1 -count=1 -run '^TestChildPlugin$' .

# An explicit arena opt-out and GOEXPERIMENT=none must reach both binaries.
env GOEXPERIMENT=none
logos test -O=1 -count=1 -run '^TestChildPlugin$' .

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/testplugin

go 1.27
-- m/arena-off.toml --
[build]
arena = false
-- m/main.go --
package testplugin
-- m/plugin/plugin.go --
package main

func Answer() int { return 42 }
-- m/plugin_test.go --
package testplugin

import (
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"plugin"
	"testing"
)

func TestChildPlugin(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child.so")
	// Bare build: the host's effective level reaches the child through
	// LOGOS_OPT_LEVEL, never through a flag on this command line.
	out, err := exec.Command("go", "build", "-buildmode=plugin", "-o", path, "./plugin").CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build child plugin: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	loaded, err := plugin.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	symbol, err := loaded.Lookup("Answer")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	answer, ok := symbol.(func() int)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Answer has type %T, want func() int", symbol)
	}
	if got := answer(); got != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("plugin Answer = %d, want 42", got)
	}
}
